g.text: PLANNED · not the implemented database schema
Proposed logical relationships from docs/prd.md; fields and indexes remain to be designed.
References use IDs; only Page layout/version content is proposed as embedded here.
Membership, RSVP, and Attendance remain independent records.
Event blocks reference Event; using a block never duplicates RSVP/Attendance.
Audits must retain recoverable prior state; delivery history survives recovery.
Not a migration or a claim that these collections or APIs exist.
